newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end up as interest rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end up as interest rates fall.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed up in thin trade lead by utility Electricidad de Caracas while interest rates fell in the Central Bank's weekly TEM auction, traders said.

The bolsa's leading index reversed two days of slippage to end up 0.84 percent at 6,427.30 points as 28 million shares traded worth 4.9 billion bolivars (US$10.4 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
"Basically it was Electricidad that fed the market's rise -- its price had fallen to what some considered attractive levels, " said InverUnion broker Hector Perez.

Lower interest rates boost prospects for increased demand and thus higher company earnings. Benchmark six month TEM yields fell 80 basis points to 16.86 percent at the Central Bank's 60 billion bolivar ($126 million) auction.
Electricidad de Caracas closed up 11.25 bolivars at 497.00.

Among total traded issues, 21 rose, 12 fell and 11 closed flat. But traders said while foreign investors continued to favor other regional markets over Venezuela a sustained rise in the bolsa was unlikely.
